opening.argument: The presentation promotes buying into a BitClub mining pool as a route to daily profit without requiring anyone to be invited. The speaker says the pool provides a share of Bitcoin mining and distributes mined bitcoins among partners according to their share, while a BitClub slide depicts pool purchase options and a daily mining share. The offer also associates inviting people with benefits and money, then directs interested viewers to contact the speaker. He says that after 15 minutes of conversation, a leader will have a bitcoin wallet and first bitcoins on it. Although the speaker frames the presentation as a comparison with other MLM companies, the purchase and income claims are presented as a direct participation offer.

citations.quote: Or buy at the start-up pool, which will bring you daily profit, even if you have not invited anyone.
And the pool allows you to have a share of bitcoin mining, and all bitcoins that are mined by the Bitcoin club, it distributes among its partners according to their share.
The BitClub company also allows you to invite people. Your friends here have already reached this point, and this will always give you a lot of benefits
If you're a leader then after 15 minutes of our talk you are going to have your own bitcoin wallet and your first bitcoins will be on it.
